As a Research Engineer in Sensor Signal Processing, you will be a key contributor to the research and development of Waabi’s signal processing stack for autonomous driving. You will collaborate with our team of world-renowned scientists and engineers to build innovative, practical, and scalable solutions that handle massive amounts of sensor data (camera, LiDAR, radar, and other modalities) with low latency and high reliability. We value original, high-impact ideas and rigorous experimental validation.
You will…
Be part of a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers working on a system that turns raw sensor data captured under diverse environments into useful signals for autonomous driving.
Design and implement novel signal processing techniques for sensor data acquisition, fusion, and filtering.
Optimize signal processing algorithms for deployment on parallel computing architectures (e.g., CPU, GPU, DSP, and specialized accelerators).
Collaborate with Waabi’s autonomy and hardware teams to ensure the robustness of the entire system.
Have the opportunity to make contributions to high-impact research papers submitted to top conferences or journals (e.g., TSP, TIP, ICRA, IROS, CVPR, NeurIPS, SIGGRAPH, HPG).
Qualifications:
Signal Processing Theory and Practice. You know how to apply insights from the underlying mathematics (Toeplitz matrices, spectral bandwidth, M-estimators) to design robust numerical algorithms that operate on data from real-world sensors.
Real-time and Embedded Systems You have experience working with high-throughput data inputs in latency-sensitive algorithms, all under a limited compute and memory budget.
Rapid Prototyping and Shipping Production Software. You are comfortable rapidly building proofs of concept in a high level language like Python, Julia, or MATLAB. You are equally comfortable reading and developing production-quality software.
Bonus:
Industry experience in 1D (audio), 2D (image), 3D (point cloud), or 4D (radar) signal processing.
Experience with numerical algorithms and mathematical optimization: BLAS, CHOLMOD, Gauss-Newton, L-BFGS, linear programming.
Experience with real-time methods: causal and recursive filters, recurrent neural networks, transformers
Experience with systems programming: buffer management, asynchronous communication, hardware accelerators.
Solid knowledge in performance profiling and optimization.

The InfoSec team protects Affirm’s systems and data from evolving threats. We manage security risk, monitor vulnerabilities, and enforce protective controls across the company. The team leads incident response, compliance, identity and access management, and employee training. Our goal is to ensure that security is built into every system and decision at Affirm. We maintain a secure, trustworthy environment so the business can operate and grow with confidence.
 In this role, you'll build and run Affirm's end-to-end security review process for enterprise AI/LLM systems evaluating architecture, prioritizing AI-specific risks, and designing the controls and guardrails that let Affirm adopt AI safely, partnering across Security, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, IT, and Engineering to make it scalable and repeatable.
 What you’ll do 
 You will lead and continuously improve Affirm's enterprise AI security review process evaluating the architecture, data flows, permissions, and design of internal AI tools, agentic/MCP-based systems, and AI features — and embed security requirements into the design phase.
 You will threat model AI/LLM-based systems and their data flows for risks such as prompt injection, insecure output handling, excessive agency, tool-permission abuse, data poisoning, and sensitive-data exposure, and drive remediation.
 You will review source code, system prompts, agent configurations, and tool/permission manifests (e.g., MCP definitions), and help tool owners build security-focused test cases and red-team/eval scenarios to verify requirements before launch.
 You will design and build security guardrails and tooling for AI systems permission boundaries, authn/authz for agentic tools and MCP servers, data-handling controls, logging/monitoring, and policy-as-code (Python, IaC) — to enforce and automate AI security.
 You will evaluate the AI capabilities of third-party SaaS vendors (e.g., Notion, Slack, Google Workspace) as part of vendor and SaaS security reviews and drive risk-based adoption decisions.
 You will identify emerging classes of AI/agentic security vulnerabilities, develop mitigations before they become incidents, and contribute to AI-specific incident response playbooks as a senior escalation point.
 You will lead cross-functional AI security initiatives to closure, advise technical and executive stakeholders as an internal point of expertise, and stay current on the AI security landscape (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS) to translate new research into practical controls.
 What we look for 
 You are a seasoned security engineer with hands-on experience designing, evaluating, and maintaining security architecture for AI/LLM-based systems, plus deep expertise in enterprise security systems, processes, and controls.
 You have practical experience threat modeling and reviewing AI/LLM applications (e.g., against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and securing agentic systems and tool-calling frameworks — MCP servers/clients, tool-permission models, and agent-to-tool trust boundaries.
 You have built AI governance artifacts (acceptable use policy, data-handling standards, vendor/model risk assessments) and evaluated AI capabilities within SaaS platforms (e.g., Notion AI, Slack AI, Google Workspace AI, GitHub Copilot) as part of vendor reviews.
 You have experience with enterprise tools for AI visibility and control (e.g., CASB, IDP/Okta) and familiarity with the corporate systems where AI is adopted (OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Jira).
 You can build security tooling, guardrails, and detections with Python or similar, and deploy cloud services and policy-as-code using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar); familiarity with Kubernetes and AWS.
 You understand how LLMs and agentic systems are built (RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning, tool use) and authn/authz models (OAuth2, SAML, service-account/non-human identities) for agentic and machine-to-machine access, with strong application-architecture and threat-modeling fundamentals.
 You can lead cross-functional initiatives across Security, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance and drive them to closure, and communicate effectively with technical and executive audiences. Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, PCI DSS) and applying IAM to non-human/agent identities is a plus.

 The Affiliate & Creator Growth Manager is responsible for building and scaling Hadley Designs' affiliate and creator partnerships into a profitable, multimillion-dollar growth engine across TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, Facebook, Instagram, and emerging channels.
 This is a strategic growth role, not simply a position focused on recruiting creators, sending samples, or managing campaigns. We're looking for someone who has successfully built and scaled affiliate programs, understands the economics behind profitable growth, and can independently identify and execute new opportunities.
 You'll own the overall affiliate growth strategy, program profitability, creator acquisition, incentive structures, and expansion into new channels. You'll lead our affiliate operations team and work closely with our Creator Partnership Lead, who specializes in coaching creators, developing relationships, and helping them improve their sales performance.
 Our approach is evolving beyond traditional TikTok Shop affiliate marketing. We see significant opportunities to help creators monetize their content across Amazon, Facebook, Instagram, and Shopify while building a loyal network of high-performing partners. Rather than measuring success by the number of creators recruited or videos posted, we prioritize building relationships with creators who consistently generate meaningful, profitable sales.
 We're looking for someone who stays.
 KPI’s 
 Affiliate Revenue: Monthly net attributed sales across TikTok Shop, Amazon, and Shopify, with duplicate sales removed > $500k
 Affiliate Contribution Profit: Monthly net affiliate profit >5%.  Revenue minus COGS, fulfillment, commissions, samples, bonuses, retainers, and attributable team costs
 Productive Affiliates: Number of unique creators generating ≥$1,000 in monthly net attributed sales > 100 per month
 New Productive Creators: Number of creators reaching ≥$1,000 in monthly net attributed sales for the first time > 10 per month
 Creator Retention Rate : Percentage of last month's productive creators who remain productive this month > 85%
 Growth Experiments Completed (Target: 2 per month): Identify, launch, and evaluate at least two new affiliate growth strategies monthly. Each experiment must have a clear hypothesis, measurable success criteria, documented results, & a recommendation to scale, improve, or discontinue. At least one experiment must explore a new growth opportunity rather than optimizing an existing process.
What Does Success Look Like?
 Success means building a profitable, scalable affiliate growth engine across TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging channels. Affiliate revenue and contribution profit grow consistently, the number of productive creators increases, and existing creators generate more sales through better partnerships, coaching, and expanded distribution.
 This person proactively identifies new growth opportunities, tests innovative strategies, and builds repeatable systems that generate measurable results. They lead our affiliate operations team and work closely with our Creator Partnership Lead to develop high-performing creators, while ensuring the program runs without constant direction from the CEO.
 Ultimately, success means building a multimillion-dollar affiliate program that consistently generates profitable revenue, develops successful creators, and continues growing through new ideas and opportunities.
 The First 90 Days
 Days 1 to 30: Audit & Identify Opportunities 
 Conduct a comprehensive audit of the existing affiliate program, including revenue and contribution profit by channel, creator performance, VIP partnerships, commissions, sampling economics, incentives, and operational systems. Evaluate opportunities across TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, Facebook, and Instagram. Identify the biggest growth constraints and deliver a prioritized plan outlining what to stop, improve, and build, including at least three new growth opportunities.
 Days 31 to 60: Implement & Experiment 
 Begin executing the highest priority recommendations. Refine creator acquisition, incentive structures, and VIP partnerships. Establish clear responsibilities with the Creator Partnership Lead and affiliate operations team. Launch at least two measurable growth experiments, including one focused on expanding affiliate revenue beyond existing channels. Implement a weekly performance scorecard tracking profitability, revenue, and productive creators.
 Days 61 to 90: Optimize & Scale 
 Evaluate experiment results and scale the most promising opportunities while discontinuing underperforming initiatives. Demonstrate measurable improvements in creator productivity, affiliate revenue, or contribution profit against the initial baseline. Establish repeatable systems for recruitment, creator development, cross-channel monetization, and performance reporting. Present a financially grounded six-month growth roadmap with specific targets, investment requirements, and expected returns.
 The 90-day objective: Take full ownership of the affiliate growth strategy, demonstrate the ability to independently identify and execute profitable growth opportunities, and build a program that operates without requiring the CEO to drive its daily strategy or execution.
 ONE THING: 
 Build and scale a multimillion-dollar, profitable affiliate and creator growth engine across all relevant sales channels by developing high-performing creator partnerships, independently identifying and executing new growth opportunities, and building repeatable systems that drive consistent revenue and profit without relying on the CEO for strategy or daily execution.
 Primary Objectives 20% BIG ROCKS – These must be done first and at all costs.
 1. Own and Scale a Profitable Affiliate Growth Program 
 Build and execute a unified affiliate growth strategy across TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, Facebook, Instagram, and emerging channels. Own revenue growth, contribution profit, channel economics, and performance tracking. Make data-driven decisions on where to invest, scale, or reduce spending.
 2. Build a High-Performing Creator Network 
 Develop a scalable system for recruiting, activating, and retaining profitable creators. Lead the affiliate operations team and collaborate with the Creator Partnership Lead to improve creator productivity, retention, and sales.
 3. Independently Identify and Execute New Growth Opportunities 
 Stay ahead of the evolving affiliate landscape by identifying emerging platforms, creator monetization strategies, AI tools, and innovative partnership models.  4. Optimize Affiliate Economics and Incentive Structures 
 Own and continuously improve commissions, sampling strategies, VIP partnerships, bonuses, and creator incentive programs. Measure the financial return of each initiative and allocate resources toward strategies that generate the greatest contribution profit rather than simply increasing GMV or creator activity.
 5. Expand Creator Monetization Across Multiple Channels

Increase the number of productive creators earning commissions across multiple channels while reducing dependence on any single platform.
 6. Build Scalable Systems and Maximize Creator Content Value

 Review channel performance weekly and identify opportunities to improve revenue and creator productivity.

 Recruit and develop strategic relationships with established creators and affiliate partners who can generate meaningful sales.

 CROSS CHANNEL GROWTH & INNOVATION

 Develop systems and educational resources that help existing creators monetize their content across multiple channels.

 Share successful creative angles, hooks, and product positioning insights with the broader marketing and product development teams.
 SYSTEMS, CRM & AI AUTOMATION

 REPORTING & ACCOUNTABILITY

 Conduct a weekly strategy and performance review with the CEO, presenting results, key insights, proposed solutions, and decisions needed.

Matador Solutions is a performance-based marketing agency that helps small and medium businesses grow. We serve more than 175 law firms and a growing number of healthcare practices. Our team contractors and employees is roughly 50+ individuals globally, and we are based out of Los Angeles. Our focus is SEO search and, now, AI search. If you have relevant experience with SEO and/or AI search, please apply! We have very low turnover, we move quickly on hiring, and we want to speak to you! If you don't have any relevant experience, it's probably not worth applying unless there's some compelling reason. Tell us that reason so we can properly consider your application. 
 The role
 Your north star is retention. You will own a portfolio of clients (mostly lawyers with some doctors), and your job is to keep them happy and winning. That means running great client calls, learning to read their performance and lead data, and always hunting for the next opportunity, whether that is a smart upsell or a new way to help their business grow.
 You will also help shape how we work. We want someone who brings ideas to the table, not just someone who executes them, and who is excited to help us build AI into our internal systems and make the whole team faster and sharper. Internally, this position is formally titled Co-op Project Manager, though you will work with clients and represent the role as a Customer Success Manager.

 Run client calls and keep communication clear, confident, and proactive.
 Learn to read lead and performance data, and turn it into recommendations clients can act on.
 Catch retention risks early and spot upsell opportunities often.
 Work with our internal teams so client work ships on time and on strategy.
 Bring ideas, ask good questions, and help us build better systems, including with AI.
 What makes you a great fit? 
 Well let's start with relevant experience. If you don't have any relevant digital marketing (SEO or AI search) experience, it's probably not worth applying.  Great with people. You build trust fast and like being someone's go-to person.
 A go-getter with experience. You have at least two years of professional experience in a client-facing role, and a lot of drive to grow fast.
 Endlessly curious. You are genuinely excited to learn this space, and to learn AI, which is changing it fast.
 A builder. You pick up new systems quickly and you are bold enough to improve them and build better ones.

 Detail-obsessed. You catch what others miss and you follow through on every commitment.

At the heart of our mission is an unwavering commitment to safety. Behavior Verification answers one question: is the driver's on-road behavior good enough to release, and how can we prove it even further? We are seeking a rigorous and decisive systems engineer to build the evidence behind that answer. You will define the scenario and test set content that various Software releases are measured against and that enable the development of new capabilities and features, establish the validity checks that keep those test sets trustworthy, and act as the gatekeeper for what enters the release pipeline. Your work directly informs whether autonomy software is promoted.
 
You will…
Design and document the scenario and test sets that establish on-road behavior performance, from minimum to comprehensive.
Own what enters the release pipeline: define and run the scenario validity checks, and approve or refuse test sets before they are used to judge a release.
Maintain continuous quality feedback of the artifacts test sets depend on — scenarios, taggers, graders and the taxonomy behind them.
Turn behavior requirements into testable criteria, working with Behavior Requirements on targets and acceptance criteria that someone will sign.
Investigate behavior deficiencies: find further instances, establish what exposure we have to them, and return them to the pipeline as test escapes.
Distinguish genuine behavior failures from simulation artifacts, and raise simulation fidelity gaps with the corresponding teams.
Work across the organization — motion planning, simulation, evaluation, operations, safety methodology and platform — and hold the interfaces between them.
Align verification phases and cadence with the organization: what runs on a daily release, and what a significant step in exposure requires.
 
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering or related field (e.g., Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Advanced Controls, Aerospace, etc.).
Experience verifying safety-critical systems, ideallyin autonomous vehicles.
Demonstrated experience designing test cases from requirements, and assessing what a test set covers and what it misses.
Applied statistics: sample size, confidence, and what a result does and does not support.
Proficiency in Python and the ability to navigate a large codebase.
Familiarity with autonomous vehicle requirements, behaviors and design methodologies.
Strong ability to structure, document and prioritize a large number of test sets and test strategies.
Ability to work cross-functionally in a diplomatic way, across teams that do not always agree.
A drive for commitment and accountability, for yourself and for others.
 
Bonus/nice to have:
Trucking or heavy-vehicle exposure.
Machine learning experience, particularly model evaluation and false-positive / false-negative trade-offs.
Exposure to regulatory frameworks: NHTSA, ISO 26262, SOTIF.
Familiarity with the tooling required to extract coverage and exposure from large driving-log sets.
Comfortable working in a newly formed team, where the process has to be built rather than followed.

The Role 
 As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you are responsible for turning our largest customers’ BeyondTrust investment into outcomes they can measure. You own the path from purchase to outcome: agreeing what success looks like with the customer’s executive sponsors and driving adoption of the solution across their teams so those outcomes are achieved and value is realised. You keep your accounts healthy and identify and mitigate risk early, building the proven value that gives the account team a strong footing to renew and grow every account. You are a trusted advisor to security and IT leadership, helping them get the most from their investment. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Value realisation: Agree measurable business outcomes and success criteria with each customer. Baseline them, track progress, and report evidence of value delivered. 
 Success plans: Build and run outcome-based success plans for every account in your book, covering each stage of the customer journey with clear milestones and owners on both sides. Track progress against the plan and escalate where delivery is off course. 
 Adoption and time to value: Drive adoption of purchased capability against entitlement, using usage data to find where value is going unrealised. Work with the customer’s teams to improve how they use the product and close the gap early. 
 Account health and risk management: Own the health of your accounts. Monitor usage, sentiment, engagement and delivery signals to identify risk early and diagnose the cause. Own the remediation plan, collaborating cross-functionally to make sure actions are created with named owners, tracked, and closed on time. Keep risks, actions and progress visible to the account team. 
 Executive engagement: Lead success reviews with sponsors that cover outcomes achieved, usage, risk and roadmap fit, and build ROI cases the customer can use internally. 
 Account team partnership: Share health, risk and value insights with Sales and Renewals so they go into renewal and expansion conversations with a clear picture of the account. Flag where realised value or new customer needs point to opportunity, and hand these to the account team to pursue. 
 Escalations: Lead the cross-functional response to escalated customer issues and manage executive-level escalations to resolution. 
 Cross-team coordination: Work with Services, Education, Technical Account Management, Support, Solution Engineers, Sales and Renewals so that delivery, technical issues and commercial activity all support the customer’s success plan. 
 Voice of the customer and advocacy: Surface feedback and feature requests to Product with business context, and develop referenceable customers and case studies. 
 Product Knowledge: Develop and maintain a strong understanding of BeyondTrust’s solutions, applying product knowledge to guide customers toward successful adoption, value realization and outcomes. 
 What You’ll Bring 
 2+ years in customer success, technical account management or a similar post-sale role, managing enterprise customers.
 A track record of driving product adoption and demonstrating measurable customer outcomes.
 Experience building and running success plans and using health scoring and usage data to identify and mitigate account risk.
 Experience leading success reviews and building credibility with senior stakeholders.
 Experience managing escalations and de-escalating customer concerns, driving cross-functional actions through to resolution.
 Ability to manage a portfolio of strategic accounts and prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment.
 Excellent written and verbal communication, including translating technical detail into business value.
 A proactive approach: anticipating risk and acting before issues escalate.
 Nice To Have 
 Cybersecurity experience, ideally privileged access management or identity security and knowledge of BeyondTrust products.
 Background in customer success, technical customer success, technical presales, technical account management or professional services.
 Awareness of cybersecurity and software trends.
 Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight and Microsoft Office.

Department: R&D- Infrastructure

ABOUT SOLINK

Trusted by over 30,000 locations across 32+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Device Management team.

This is an engineering role first: you'll design and build test automation frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure that let the whole team ship confidently at speed. You'll write real code, against our Rust/Node.js APIs, our React front end, and our AWS serverless infrastructure, to make the system testable, simulate device behavior at scale, and catch problems before they reach customers. You'll work as a peer to developers, contributing to architecture discussions, code reviews, and design decisions, with quality and testability as your lens.

You'll have significant latitude to shape how the team approaches testing, from framework design to CI/CD integration to how we simulate thousands of IoT devices and video streams in a repeatable, automated way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Automation Framework & Tooling Development

 - Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and libraries spanning REST APIs, UI (React), security, and end-to-end/integration layers.

 - Write production-quality code for test harnesses, device simulators, performance tools and mocks that emulate IoT device behavior and video streams at scale.

 - Build and maintain tooling that improves testability across the stack — including for distributed, event-driven components (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, Kinesis).

 - Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, optimizing for fast, reliable feedback on every build and deployment.

 - Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and approaches to keep test infrastructure scalable as the platform and team grow.

Engineering Collaboration & Architecture

 - Participate as a technical peer in design sessions, RFCs, and architecture discussions — advocating for testability, observability, and reliability from the start.

 - Review code and pull requests with an eye toward correctness, edge cases, performance, and long-term maintainability.

 - Work closely with backend and frontend engineers to understand system design and build automation that reflects real production behavior.

 - Contribute to system reliability by supporting monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting efforts, including issues involving device connectivity.

Test Strategy & Coverage

 - Design test plans and strategies for new and existing features, deciding where automation adds the most value versus targeted manual/exploratory testing.

 - Drive test coverage for IoT device configuration, monitoring, deployment, and connectivity workflows, as well as video playback, recording, and streaming features.

 - Validate distributed cloud systems for correctness, performance, and resilience under realistic and edge-case load.

 - Own test estimation and planning as part of sprint and release cycles, working directly with engineering leads.

Quality Leadership

 - Act as a proactive voice for quality across the engineering org — identifying systemic risks early and proposing engineering solutions (not just flagging bugs).

 - Mentor other engineers and QA team members on automation practices, framework usage, and testable design.

 - Provide direct, technically grounded feedback to developers and stakeholders when quality or architecture decisions are at risk.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must-Have:

 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong hands-on coding ability — this is a build-things role, not primarily a manual-execution role.

 - Strong programming skills in Python, plus working proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Rust, sufficient to build and maintain real test infrastructure and tooling.

 - Demonstrated experience designing and building test automation frameworks from the ground up (API, UI, or integration layers), not just using existing ones.

 - Comfortable working in Linux environments.

 - Solid understanding of AWS services (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, Kinesis, or similar) and how they underpin distributed, serverless SaaS applications.

 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and treating test infrastructure as a first-class engineering deliverable.

 - Ability to read and reason about production code, participate meaningfully in code reviews, and collaborate with developers as a technical peer.

 - Strong systems thinking — able to reason about distributed, event-driven, and resilience-focused architectures.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to give direct, technically substantiated feedback to developers and stakeholders.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical/engineering experience.

Nice-to-Have:

 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (CDK, Terraform, Serverless Framework) for provisioning test environments.

 - Experience with IoT device communication protocols and building device simulators for test purposes.

 - Experience with video development, video streaming technologies, or testing video pipelines.

 - Familiarity with production monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch).

 - Experience with Snowflake, Elasticsearch, or other cloud-native data platforms.

 - Contributions to open-source testing/automation tools, or strong personal projects demonstrating framework design skills.

 - Prior experience in a fast-growing SaaS environment.

 - Interest in eventually contributing to product code, or a background that blends SDET and full-stack development work.

SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

We do things the Solink way:

   

WHY SOLINK?

 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager
